acceptanceCriteria: A decision records whether derived closure scopes are sound for AFP-V0-023, naming what a derived list cannot cover (embedded files, go:generate, non-Go reads).
If adopted: the closure is derived, not hand-maintained, and a test shows a new import does not break the confined run.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

From the V1-0868 lane (2026-10-06). Five units (analyzer-rust, analyzer-shader, analyzerstructured, mcp-test-validity-v0, liveverify/provider) pass all three read-scope measurement steps when their binary's import closure (47 to about 95 directories) is declared, which would remove up to 5 more selected units per PR. Coordinator decision: not adopted by hand, because every new import into cmd/corvint would break the confined CI run until the list is edited. The open question is whether the closure can be derived from go list -deps at selection time so it cannot drift.
title: Generate import-closure read scopes mechanically instead of hand-listing them
